annotation_method: Human-reviewed source-note scope, impact and event dates; content hashes prevent stale annotations. Unknown notes cannot automatically justify an increase.

policy.basis: Review partial event weeks when uncovered shipments alone contribute at least five percentage points of aggregate rise, matching the default minimum-rise threshold. These tolerances are review policies, not source facts.

N001.window_basis: Explicit dates in the source note; roads passable by March 9.

N002.window_basis: Festival week: the Monday-to-Sunday week containing the note date.

N003.window_basis: Nationwide fuel step starts this week; no end date stated. Reject once absorbed by all history weeks.

N004.exclusion_reason: The affected routes are explicitly outside this dataset.

N005.exclusion_reason: Maintenance caused delays but costs were not significantly affected.

N006.exclusion_reason: Stable demand and no major disruptions do not explain an increase.

N007.exclusion_reason: Improved roads provide no evidence of increased freight costs.

N008.exclusion_reason: Freight movement remained normal, with no significant disruption.

N009.exclusion_reason: Confirms recovery; it does not extend the expired flooding window.

N010.exclusion_reason: Compliance costs were absorbed without a rate change.
